name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It asks Nicaragua's government to release Carlos Brenes, Salvadora Martínez and all other political prisoners, and to cancel their politically motivated convictions. It condemns the government's repression and calls for an investigation into the death in custody of indigenous leader Brooklyn Rivera. It also asks the European Union to expand sanctions and suspend its association agreement with Nicaragua while repression continues.

- The European Union is asked to suspend its association agreement with Nicaragua and widen sanctions.
- The demands target Nicaragua's government and affect detained opponents and their families.
- The Parliament will not meet regime representatives in the new joint committee.
